crossRefs.note: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”
On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali,

people.name: Ahira
people.line: Leader of the tribe of Naphtali during the Exodus

people.name: Enan
people.line: Father of Ahira, a leader of the tribe of Naphtali.

people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

translations.web: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.
translations.bsb: and Ahira son of Enan was over the division of the tribe of Naphtali.
translations.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
translations.asv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
